title: Voiceover Pack (Fighter) · Kenney
og_description: Download this package (45 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!
use_cases: round and match call-outs (round 1-5, fight, final round, sudden death)
match result announcements (you win, you lose, flawless victory, game over)
game mode intros (arcade, story, survival, battle, deathmatch, championship)
player slot prompts (player 1, player 2, choose your character)
prototype audio for arcade, brawler, and combat prototypes
visual_summary: Kenney brand cover on a flat teal/mint background: a white circular disc holding a simplified grey loudspeaker icon, paired with a small dark rounded-square chat-style badge showing a crossed-swords combat glyph. Minimal, flat, friendly modern illustration that signals 'audio + fighting/combat'.

zip_inventory.audio_layout: All clips in a single Audio/ folder, lowercase_underscore filenames matching the spoken line (e.g. fight.ogg, round_1.ogg, you_win.ogg, combo_breaker.ogg, sudden_death.ogg)
